4. Committed interaction snapshots can contain historically “open” states for now-merged PRs. Use PR numbers as provenance and first-parent merge history for integration evidence; avoid asserting current remote PR state.
5. No full Spack lock snapshot is committed in the reviewed sources. Known package observations do not enumerate or qualify every transitive Spack package.
